title_en: Guan Zhicheng — bribery and embezzlement case
keywords_en: criminal; acceptance of bribes; embezzlement; first instance; second instance; approval of death penalty; Supreme People's Court; High People's Court; Intermediate People's Court; Beijing; natural person; Criminal Law; Supplementary Provisions of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Punishment of Crimes of Embezzlement and Bribery; determination of facts of acceptance of bribes; determination of facts of embezzlement; whether voluntary confession; whether the report of others' crimes is true; affirm the original judgment; abuse of official position; soliciting bribes; settle accounts with false invoices
full_text_en:
Guan Zhicheng — Bribery and Embezzlement Case

Defendant: Guan Zhicheng, male, 59 years old, formerly Secretary of the Party Committee of the Beijing Steel Company, Capital Steel Company. He was arrested on April 29, 1990.

The Branch Procuratorate of Beijing Municipal People's Procuratorate initiated a public prosecution against the defendant Guan Zhicheng for the crimes of bribery and embezzlement before the Beijing Intermediate People's Court. The Beijing Intermediate People's Court, after public trial, found the following facts:

1. The defendant Guan Zhicheng, as the mastermind, in collusion with Yu Huirong (already sentenced to life imprisonment), between June 1989 and February 1990, took advantage of his official position, in the course of business activities of contacting and arranging for the purchase, sale, and transportation of steel products between the Distribution Department of Capital Steel Company and units including Fujian Xiamen Jiuzhou Huacheng United Industry and Trade Company, Quanzhou Urban Area Enterprise Supply and Marketing Company Jinjiang Managerial Department, Changle County Jinfeng Metal Rolling Plant, Guangdong Shenzhen Material Transportation Industry and Trade Company, Zhanjiang Economic and Technological Development Company, and Jiangsu Wujin County Metal Recycling Company, under the pretexts of "extra-plan wagon transportation fees," "material quota fees," and "profit sharing," successively demanded and accepted bribes from the above units totaling RMB 432,400, HK$20,000 (equivalent to RMB 9,532), and one gold necklace (worth RMB 500).

2. The defendant Guan Zhicheng, between August 1986 and April 1990, took advantage of his official position, in the course of business activities of contacting and arranging for the purchase and sale of steel products, sale of automobiles, and promotion of coal for units including the Beijing Working Group of the Materials Management Office of the Second Engineering Bureau of the Ministry of Railways, the Beijing Company of the Materials General Corporation of the Ministry of Railways, the Liwan District Metal Materials Supply and Marketing Company of Guangzhou, Guangdong Province, Fengrun County Sheet Metal Plant of Hebei Province, Fengrun County Second Steel Rolling Mill, Tangshan Third Steel Rolling Mill, Shijiazhuang Prefecture Township Enterprise Supply and Marketing Company, Dagezhuang Smelting Plant of Fangshan District, Beijing, Beijing Dahua Auto Parts Factory, Suzhou Xitang Comprehensive Business Department of Jiangsu Province, and Unit 5126 of the People's Liberation Army stationed in Shanxi, under the pretexts of "intermediary fees," "extra-plan wagon transportation fees," "service fees," "price difference compensation," and "processing fees," successively demanded and accepted bribes from the counterparties totaling RMB 955,000 and 28 tons of steel (worth RMB 20,000).

3. The defendant Guan Zhicheng, between August and November 1988, in the name of Shougang Mining Company, jointly with the Factory Bureau of the Logistics Department of the Beijing Military Region and Jiangsu Fuyou Company, established the Hongcheng Industry and Trade Business Department of Wuxian County, Jiangsu Province, and Guan Zhicheng served as Chairman of the Board. In August of the same year, Guan Zhicheng, taking advantage of his position as Chairman, temporarily deposited more than RMB 82,600 of the business department's payment for ordered steel into the account of Dagezhuang Smelting Plant in Fangshan District, Beijing. Thereafter, Guan Zhicheng used false invoices issued in the name of Dagezhuang Smelting Plant for "additional extra-plan wagon transportation fees" and "management fees" totaling RMB 82,600 to settle accounts with Hongcheng Industry and Trade Business Department, thereby appropriating the funds.

In summary, the defendant Guan Zhicheng, alone or in collusion, accepted bribes totaling more than RMB 1,417,000 and embezzled more than RMB 82,600. The illicit gains obtained by Guan Zhicheng were used to purchase houses for his son and mistress and for squandering.

The above facts are confirmed by physical evidence, documentary evidence, and witness testimony. The defendant Guan Zhicheng also confessed to the crimes.

The Beijing Intermediate People's Court held that: The defendant Guan Zhicheng, as a state functionary, took advantage of his official position to accept bribes, and his conduct constitutes the crime of bribery as stipulated in Article 185, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law. Guan Zhicheng took advantage of his official position to embezzle public funds, and his conduct constitutes the crime of embezzlement as stipulated in Article 155, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law. The amount of bribes accepted by Guan Zhicheng was especially huge; pursuant to Article 5 of the Supplementary Provisions of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on the Punishment of Crimes of Embezzlement and Bribery, punishment shall be imposed in accordance with Item (1) of Article 2 of those Provisions. The amount of public funds embezzled by Guan Zhicheng was especially huge; punishment shall be imposed in accordance with Item (1) of Article 2 of those Provisions. Guan Zhicheng committed multiple crimes; pursuant to Article 64 of the Criminal Law, he shall be punished for multiple crimes in conjunction. Based on the criminal facts and circumstances of Guan Zhicheng, pursuant to Article 53, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law, he should be deprived of political rights for life. Pursuant to Article 155, Paragraph 2 of the Criminal Law, Guan Zhicheng's personal property should also be confiscated. The illicit articles seized from Guan Zhicheng shall be recovered pursuant to Article 60 of the Criminal Law.

Accordingly, the Beijing Intermediate People's Court rendered judgment on July 18, 1991:

1. The defendant Guan Zhicheng is convicted of bribery and sentenced to death, with deprivation of political rights for life; convicted of embezzlement and sentenced to life imprisonment, with deprivation of political rights for life; the combined sentence is death, with deprivation of political rights for life.

2. All personal property of Guan Zhicheng is confiscated.

3. Three houses and one refrigerated truck purchased by Guan Zhicheng with illicit gains are recovered.

After the first-instance verdict was announced, the defendant Guan Zhicheng appealed to the Beijing High People's Court on the grounds that some facts found in the original judgment were incorrect, and that he had voluntarily confessed and reported others' crimes.

The Beijing High People's Court, upon trial, held that: The appellant Guan Zhicheng, as a state functionary, took advantage of his position to accept bribes and embezzle public funds. The amounts were especially huge and the circumstances were especially serious, warranting severe punishment. Guan Zhicheng only began to truthfully confess after the judicial authorities had already mastered most of the criminal facts and after repeated education. This was not voluntary confession. As for his reporting of others' crimes, investigation did not substantiate it. The original trial found facts clearly, convicted correctly, and sentenced appropriately. Guan Zhicheng's grounds of appeal are untenable. Pursuant to Item (1) of Article 136 of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the court ruled on August 21, 1991: To reject the appeal of the appellant Guan Zhicheng and affirm the first-instance judgment.

The Beijing High People's Court, pursuant to Article 144 of the Criminal Procedure Law, submitted the ruling sentencing Guan Zhicheng to death with deprivation of political rights for life to the Supreme People's Court for approval.

The Supreme People's Court, upon review, held that: The defendant Guan Zhicheng took advantage of his position to accept bribes and embezzle public funds, and his acts constitute the crimes of bribery and embezzlement respectively. The amounts of bribes accepted and funds embezzled by Guan Zhicheng were especially huge, and the circumstances were especially serious, and he should be severely punished according to law. The first-instance judgment and second-instance ruling found Guan Zhicheng's criminal facts clearly, with evidence truthful and sufficient, conviction accurate, and sentencing appropriate. Accordingly, the Supreme People's Court ruled on August 27, 1991: To approve the criminal ruling of the Beijing High People's Court affirming the first-instance judgment sentencing the defendant Guan Zhicheng to death with deprivation of political rights for life for bribery, to life imprisonment with deprivation of political rights for life for embezzlement, and to death with deprivation of political rights for life as the combined sentence.
